note: Deterministic news-linker fixture for pipelines/qa.test.mjs. Nothing is fetched at test time. Titles and ledes are synthetic sentences built only from real entity names and aliases that exist in research/J-nieuwsbronnen.json; they assert nothing about the world. URLs use the reserved .invalid TLD. kind 'positive' means a real entity name or alias appears and must link; kind 'negative' means the sentence must not produce a high-confidence wrong link.
